blocks.en: Fill in the I'iraab; write the analysis (Tarkeeb) and translation for the following Sentences. Include the BTM wherever it is required.
As if the book is a teacher.
Would that the moon were rising.
The traveller is coming, but he is late.
Perhaps I will return to the people.
Indeed Allah is powerful over everything.
He only commands you with evil.

blocks.ar: مَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَان وَ {{term|لٰكِنَّ}} الشَّيَاطِين كَفَرُوْا
blocks.en: Sulaymaan did not disbelieve, but the devils disbelieved.
I know that the exam is near.
It pleases me that Zayd is a human being.
I became angry that the door is broken.
Know that Allah is with the God-fearing.
Using the HMF, translate the following into Arabic then write the analysis (Tarkeeb) for your translation.

items: Khalid informed me that his son woke up for Fajr.
Indeed the believers will enter Jannah.
Perhaps Allah will make it easy for me.
I study at (in) As-Suffa Institue, however it is challenging.
